## Executive Overview

Aequs Limited reported its Q4 FY2025-26 and full-year FY2025-26 earnings, highlighting a landmark year characterized by strong execution, significant business expansion, and its successful IPO. The company achieved robust year-on-year revenue growth of 33% to ₹12,304 Mn for FY26, with EBITDA growing 43% to ₹1,545 Mn, indicating operational leverage as programs mature. The Aerospace segment, supported by a substantial order book of USD 889 million, continued its steady growth. The Consumer segment demonstrated impressive acceleration, with 84% YoY growth in FY26 as programs scaled into full production. Strategic initiatives, including MoUs with state governments for significant investments in both aerospace and consumer segments, underscore the company's long-term manufacturing ambitions in India. Aequs is focused on deepening its manufacturing presence, strengthening capabilities, and advancing its Aerospace portfolio towards higher-margin, complex programs.

## Key Financial Metrics

| Metric (FY26)          | Value        | YoY Change | Notes                                                                                                                                          |
| :--------------------- | :----------- | :--------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Revenue                | ₹ 12,304 Mn  | 33%        | Driven by strong traction across segments and scaling of operations.                                                                           |
| EBITDA                 | ₹ 1,545 Mn   | 43%        | Reflects operating leverage and improved capacity utilization.                                                                                 |
| EBITDA Margin          | 13%          | +100 bps   | Improved margins driven by operating leverage and better capacity utilization.                                                                 |
| Profit/(Loss) after Tax | (₹ 1,133 Mn) | N/A        | Net loss primarily due to higher depreciation, taxation, and ₹76 Mn in one-time share issue and labour code expenses. PAT margin improved to -9%. |
